name: Takeomi Takagi
source:
“Whatever happens, do not betray to your dream.”

The Player character.

Takagi is 3rd high school student who is very strict and sharp tongue. 

He is only member who remains in Art club. His goal is to win over art competition before his graduation from high school. 

He tries to help Eimi achieve her dream because of his regret in the past but he never mentions his reason to his junior.
